thread:
Anya Patel: quick sync — finalizing ops readiness gating for the launch. Need to lock KPIs, pricing gates, docs & oncall handoff by EOD Friday. Who's owning the acceptance checklist? :spiral_calendar:
Mike Chen: I can own the KPI acceptance matrix. will put a short rubric: latency, error rate, cost-per-1000-tokens.
Sasha Ivanov: For thresholds propose: P50 < 120ms, P95 < 400ms, error-rate < 0.5% over 24h baseline. if those fail -> block GA.
Leo Martinez: pricing gate question — do we require a paid commit before GA or allow a soft-launch with rate-limits? need finance input.
Priya Singh: docs/playbook status: runbook draft is ready, but we need a clear oncall escalation flow and example incident templates. I'll add RCA template today.
Mike Chen: I'll add a quick cost guard in the checklist: alert when cost-per-req estimated > 2x expected for 6h. if triggered, ops rollback + notify sales.
Anya Patel: good. decision: soft-launch allowed but must enable customer-tiered rate-limits and quota mapping. finance to confirm billing thresholds by Thu COB.
Leo Martinez: noted — I'll ping finance. also we should gate GA on pricing docs being published (public pricing + FAQ). otherwise sales will get noisy.
Sasha Ivanov: monitoring hooks — need synthetic tests per route, end-to-end traces, and a canary traffic split (5% -> 20% over 48h). canary failure policy = automatic rollback if P95 spikes > 50% vs baseline.
Priya Singh: support readiness: define 2-week triage window for unexpected regressions, provide playbook with customer-facing doc and internal triage checklist. I'll draft both.
Mike Chen: ownership summary: KPI matrix -> @Mike, Monitoring canaries & rollback -> @Sasha, Pricing gating & finance sync -> @Leo, Docs & runbooks -> @Priya, Launch coordinator -> @Anya.
Anya Patel: timeline: lock checklist by Fri EOD, run full canary + smoke tests next Mon-Tue, publish pricing + docs before Wed, green light for soft GA on Thu if gates pass.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/launch-readiness -> Tue 03:00 UTC. Triggered by @Anya.
Leo Martinez: one more item — quota mapping for free tier: cap at 50 RPS per org, burst 100 for 30s. add to checklist.
Sasha Ivanov: added. small note: we need a post-launch metric digest for week1 (latency, errors, cost delta, major regressions). who owns weekly digest?
Priya Singh: I'll own week1 digest and coordinate with product for any customer comms.
Anya Patel: perfect. I'll update the checklist doc with these owners and publish link in this thread after update. please flag any missing gate you think is critical. :raised_hands:
